parameters.name: labor_hours_per_unit_raw
parameters.description: Labor hours required per unit of raw material for each product

parameters.name: raw_material_supply
parameters.description: Raw material supply available in each period

parameters.name: labor_capacity
parameters.description: Regular labor hours available in each period

parameters.name: equipment_capacity
parameters.description: Processing capacity of each equipment type in each period

parameters.name: compatible_equipment
parameters.description: Compatible equipment type required for each product

parameters.name: demand_upper_bound
parameters.description: Optional sales upper bound for each product in each period

variables.name: production_quantity
variables.description: Quantity of product produced in each period

variables.name: raw_material_allocation
variables.description: Amount of raw material assigned to each product in each period

variables.name: labor_usage
variables.description: Labor hours used for each product in each period

variables.name: sales_quantity
variables.description: Quantity of product sold in each period

variables.name: total_profit
variables.description: Total profit over the planning horizon

constraints.name: raw_material_capacity
constraints.description: Total raw material consumption across all products in each period must not exceed available supply

constraints.name: labor_capacity
constraints.description: Total regular labor usage across all products in each period must not exceed available labor hours

constraints.name: equipment_compatibility
constraints.description: Each product may only be produced on its compatible equipment type

constraints.name: equipment_capacity
constraints.description: Processing burden assigned to each equipment type in each period must not exceed its capacity; infinite capacity means no cap

constraints.name: sales_upper_bound
constraints.description: If demand upper bounds are provided, sales for each product in each period cannot exceed them; otherwise sales are unrestricted

constraints.name: production_resource_consistency
constraints.description: Raw material usage, labor usage, and output quantities must be consistent with product-specific yield and labor requirements
constraints.formula: x_{p,t} = \alpha_p m_{p,t},\; \ell_{p,t} = \beta_p m_{p,t},\; s_{p,t} = x_{p,t} \quad \forall p\in\mathcal{P},\forall t\in\mathcal{T}

constraints.name: nonnegative_raw_material_allocation
constraints.description: Raw material allocations must be nonnegative

constraints.name: profit_variable_definition
constraints.description: Total profit equals the sum of unit profits times sales quantities over the planning horizon

constraints.name: data_nonnegativity
constraints.description: All supplied data quantities are nonnegative where applicable; supplies, labor availability, capacities, and finite demand bounds are nonnegative, and infinite values indicate uncapped limits
constraints.formula: input data values are nonnegative when finite

constraints.name: continuous_variables
constraints.description: Decision variables are continuous unless integrality is imposed externally

constraints.name: finite_or_unrestricted_capacity
constraints.description: Finite capacities and demand bounds constrain the model, while plus infinity denotes no restriction
constraints.formula: +infty indicates no cap on capacity or demand

objectives.name: total_profit_maximization
objectives.description: Maximize total profit over the planning horizon

final_objective.description: Maximize total profit over the planning horizon, where profit equals the sum of unit profits times sales quantities.
